items.headline: CoreWeave bond yield tops 16% as AI credit stress rises; 5-year CDS spikes above 1,289bp
items.note: CoreWeave CDS widened past its October peak and bonds fell to ~79.5 cents, showing sharply higher funding costs for the largest neocloud borrower (no default or forced action yet).

items.headline: AI credit selloff spreads: Nvidia, Broadcom, Amazon and SpaceX CDS widen
items.note: Reported month-over-month CDS increases at large AI-linked names (Nvidia +76%, Broadcom +49%, Amazon +44%) suggest stress is broadening beyond neoclouds; figures are secondary-source.
